rows.label: tlk70000023_02_msg0002
rows.name:
In Acedia, they call Heaven's Holy
Grail a revelation from God, but this
looks like some kind of demon!

rows.label: tlk70000023_02_msg0003
rows.name:
If only that Knight-sama...
Ornella-sama... were here now...

rows.label: tlk70000023_02_msg0004
rows.name:
You may not know this, but when
I was little, Haiber Village had
a truly splendid knight.

rows.label: tlk70000023_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Ornella-sama was not just strong,
she was kind. And exceptionally
beautiful, so they said.
